syntheses.title: Lack of Robust Solutions to Error Accumulation and Distribution Shift in Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving Systems
syntheses.body: While mid-level representations and closed-loop simulations facilitate training and validation of autonomous driving models (claims cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24, 5fc32090-a96e-5352-b867-05795d95ae56, ff265183-ca72-5222-91bf-17b21808b0f6), there remains a significant limitation due to error accumulation and distribution shift when running these systems in closed-loop (claim c9759883-dd81-58a9-ab2d-155a512245df). This gap highlights the need for methods that can effectively mitigate these issues to improve real-world deployment reliability.

syntheses.title: Insufficient Effectiveness of Pure Imitation Learning Despite Large Datasets and Mid-Level Representations
syntheses.body: Despite the use of large-scale datasets and mid-level input/output representations in autonomous driving models (claims 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf, 5fc32090-a96e-5352-b867-05795d95ae56), pure imitation learning approaches remain insufficient for robust driving performance (claims 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf, 09081b52-e1ad-5843-9bbc-8565cf5aea59). This gap indicates the necessity for alternative or complementary learning strategies to overcome the limitations of imitation learning.

syntheses.title: Need for More Reliable End-to-End Neural Network Systems to Replace Modular Approaches in Off-Road Driving
syntheses.body: Early end-to-end systems like DAVE were trained on human driving data and demonstrated some success (claims 1f44da23-b078-5b48-9c3b-0f7f3315f522, f78de3ab-0095-5d09-a3ae-9f15b81a03b6), but were not reliable enough to fully replace modular pipelines in off-road driving (claim 0b57eda2-4239-505d-a1df-0db0acbd35c8). This gap points to the need for improved end-to-end learning methods with higher reliability and robustness for practical deployment.
